# Distribution and promotion agreement

This agreement is made between ⟦ORG|Fenwick Orchard Cider LLC⟧ (“Company”) and XXXXXXXX (“Distributor”). Distributor shall buy the cider from Company and resell it in the region. Distributor’s Affiliates may resell it too, and Distributor shall report its sales to Company each month.

⟦ORG|Saltmarsh Live Ltd⟧ (hereinafter referred to as the “Promoter”) engages ⟦PERSON|Ottilie Marsk⟧ (the “Performer”) for the summer tour. The Promoter pays the Performer within ten days; the Performer’s fee is net of tax. ⟦ORG|Corrow Glassworks Inc⟧ (the “Manufacturer”) supplies the bottles, and the Manufacturer invoices Distributor. ⟦ORG|Lowmoor Distributors Ltd⟧ carries the goods.

Either party may disclose information (each a “Disclosing Party” or “Receiving Party”). The Receiving Party keeps it secret, and the Disclosing Party may ask for it back. The party that indemnifies (the “Indemnifying Party”) holds the other (the “Indemnified Party”) harmless; the Indemnified Party gives notice first.

Distributor shall pay Company, Distributor shall keep the books, and Distributor shall not assign this agreement.
